## Problem / Use Case

What problem are you trying to solve? What is the use case?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you considered.

## Impact on Existing Behavior

Would this change alter existing behavior? If so, how?

## Impact on Security / Policy

Could this change affect the security model, policy enforcement, or mandatory safety rules? If so, describe how.

## Impact on the Seven-Tool Ecosystem

Does this change require modifications to any of the seven companion tool repositories? If so, which ones and why?

## Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, or references.
